contributions.detail: Four inked Form A rows: 20.00, 200.00, 100.00, 100.00. The three rows OVER $50 sum to exactly 400.00 = cover line 1 (identical in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns; the LAST column holds a bare dash = blank, this being the first report of the cycle). The fourth row, Mike Vaughan 20.00, is a $50-OR-LESS contribution which this filer chose to itemise voluntarily on Form A as well as reporting it in the line-2 aggregate (20.00 in both columns) - so all four rows together sum to 420.00 = line 1 + line 2. Scored against line 1 per the sub-$50 aggregate rule; all four rows are published because all four are real itemised lines on the page. THIS = CUMULATIVE, first report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: Eleven Form B rows sum to EXACTLY 1183.05 = cover line 3, printed identically in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns (LAST is a bare dash = blank). First report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide - recorded cumulative.
